sin.name: import-in-function
sin.description: An import written inside a function or method: the module loads on the first call instead of at boot, and the import most often hides a cycle between two modules.
sin.rule: Every import sits at the top of its module. Where a cycle stands in the way, move what both modules need (most often a feature's options or constants) into a module of its own that both import, or pass it in through the constructor; never hide the import in a body.
